spec.description: Fleet-level overview of Alloy SNMP devices (snmp_* / recording rules). Interface bps is if:snmp_ifHC*:rate5m * 8. Fleet tabs: Routing, Interfaces, Hardware, Resources, Events; drill links → alloy-device-details.

spec.title: Unhealthy Pollers
spec.description: Devices whose Alloy SNMP hot-tier target is down.

spec.title: SNMP Collectors
spec.description: Alloy SNMP exporter instances (hot / cold / topology scrape jobs).

spec.title: Flow Collectors
spec.description: Active Alloy NetFlow receiver instances emitting flow metrics.

spec.title: Syslog/Trap Collectors
spec.description: Distinct Alloy event streams with data in the last 15m (alloy-syslog, alloy-snmptrap).

spec.title: Memory by Device
spec.description: Memory % from device:snmp_MemoryUtilization:percent (Grafana-managed rule).

spec.title: Memory Utilization — Top 10
spec.description: Memory % trend from device:snmp_MemoryUtilization:percent.

spec.title: Top Interface Errors (fleet)
spec.description: Sum of in+out error rates per interface, from the precomputed 5m error rate rules.

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by(device_name, if_interface_name, snmp_group) (if:snmp_ifInErrors:rate5m{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"}) + sum by(device_name, if_interface_name, snmp_group) (if:snmp_ifOutErrors:rate5m{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"}))

spec.title: Top Interface Utilization (bps)
spec.description: Highest combined in+out throughput per interface, from the precomputed 5m octet rate rules.

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by(device_name, if_interface_name, snmp_group) (if:snmp_ifHCInOctets:rate5m{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} * 8) + sum by(device_name, if_interface_name, snmp_group) (if:snmp_ifHCOutOctets:rate5m{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} * 8))

spec.title: BGP Established % by Device
spec.description: Share of BGP peers in established state per device.

spec.expr:
sort_desc(
  100 * count by(device_name, snmp_group) (snmp_tBgpPeerNgConnState{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} == 6)
  / count by(device_name, snmp_group) (snmp_tBgpPeerNgConnState{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"})
)

spec.title: BGP Peers Established
spec.description: Count of established BGP sessions fleet-wide.

spec.title: BGP Peers Total
spec.description: All BGP peers being polled.

spec.title: BGP Sessions Not Established
spec.description: Peers where tBgpPeerNgConnState is not established (6).

spec.title: BGP Flaps (range)
spec.description: Peer flap counter increase over dashboard time range.

spec.title: Devices with Hardware Issues
spec.description: Count of devices with any chassis component not inService (2).

spec.title: Max Temperature by Device
spec.description: Highest chassis/sensor temperature (°C) per device.

spec.title: Temperature Over Time
spec.description: Chassis temperature trend (top 10 devices).

spec.title: Non-inService Components
spec.description: Chassis, PSU, or fan components where tmnxHwOperState is not in service (2).

spec.title: Collectors by Type
spec.description: SNMP = devices with a hot scrape; NetFlow = Alloy flow receiver; Syslog/Traps = Loki streams in the last 15m.

spec.title: Total Interfaces
spec.description: IF-MIB interfaces polled fleet-wide.

spec.title: Admin-Up Interfaces
spec.description: Interfaces with ifAdminStatus != down.

spec.title: Oper-Up Interfaces
spec.description: Interfaces currently oper-up (ifOperStatus == 1).

spec.title: Recent SNMP Traps
spec.description: Recent SNMP traps from Alloy loki.source.snmptrap (JSON body; trap_oid + device_name labels).

spec.title: Trap Types (range)
spec.description: SNMP trap counts over the range grouped by trap_oid. IF-MIB linkDown=.5.3, linkUp=.5.4. MIB names are not resolving yet.

spec.title: WAN Traffic by Interface
spec.description: Interfaces with if_Alias matching .*WAN.*, joined from snmp_ifAdminStatus onto the precomputed 5m octet rate rules.

spec.expr: topk(20, (sum by(device_name, if_interface_name, if_Alias, snmp_group) (if:snmp_ifHCInOctets:rate5m{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} * 8 * on(device_name, ifIndex) group_left(if_Alias) (max by (device_name, ifIndex, if_Alias) (snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name",if_Alias=~".*WAN.*"})))) + (sum by(device_name, if_interface_name, if_Alias, snmp_group) (if:snmp_ifHCOutOctets:rate5m{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} * 8 * on(device_name, ifIndex) group_left(if_Alias) (max by (device_name, ifIndex, if_Alias) (snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name",if_Alias=~".*WAN.*"})))))

spec.title: WAN Traffic Over Time
spec.description: Stacked bps on WAN-tagged interfaces, joined from snmp_ifAdminStatus onto the precomputed 5m octet rate rules.

spec.expr: sum by(device_name, if_Alias, snmp_group) (if:snmp_ifHCInOctets:rate5m{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} * 8 * on(device_name, ifIndex) group_left(if_Alias) (max by (device_name, ifIndex, if_Alias) (snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name",if_Alias=~".*WAN.*"}))) + sum by(device_name, if_Alias, snmp_group) (if:snmp_ifHCOutOctets:rate5m{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} * 8 * on(device_name, ifIndex) group_left(if_Alias) (max by (device_name, ifIndex, if_Alias) (snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name",if_Alias=~".*WAN.*"})))

spec.title: Non-OK Fans
spec.description: Chassis fans where tmnxPhysChassisFanOperStatus is not in service (2).

spec.title: Non-OK Power Supplies
spec.description: PSUs where tmnxPhysChassisPMOutputStatus deviates from the healthy baseline (4).

spec.title: Fan Issues
spec.description: Fans where tmnxPhysChassisFanOperStatus is not in service (2) — Device, fan index, state.

spec.title: Power Supply Issues
spec.description: PSUs where tmnxPhysChassisPMOutputStatus deviates from the healthy baseline (4).

spec.title: Devices by Polling Tier
spec.description: Unique devices grouped by SNMP polling tier (hot/cold).

spec.title: Device Inventory
spec.description: Fleet inventory: device, SNMP group, system name, and uptime.

spec.title: Devices by SNMP group
spec.description: Unique devices grouped by snmp_group (Alloy SNMP fleet group).

spec.title: SNMP Trap Volume
spec.description: SNMP trap volume over time grouped by trap_oid ({service_name=alloy-snmptrap}).

spec.title: Active Network Alerts
spec.description: Firing alerts, label category=network.

spec.title: Traffic Out — Top 10 Devices (Stacked)
spec.description: Outbound traffic (bps) over time for the top 10 devices by volume, from the precomputed 5m octet rate rule.

spec.title: Internal Log Volume by Severity
spec.description: Alloy collector log volume by detected_level ({service_name=alloy}). Not device syslog.

spec.title: Alloy Collector Logs
spec.description: Alloy process logs mentioning this device filter. Device syslog/traps are the rows above.

spec.title: Avg CPU by SNMP Group
spec.description: Average of each device's CPU, grouped by snmp_group (Alloy SNMP fleet group).

spec.title: Total Traffic by SNMP Group
spec.description: Sum of inbound + outbound bits/sec, grouped by snmp_group, from the precomputed 5m octet rate rules.

spec.title: Interfaces Down by SNMP Group
spec.description: Count of oper-down interfaces (admin-up only), grouped by snmp_group.

spec.expr: sort_desc((count by(snmp_group) (snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} == 2 and on(device_name, ifIndex) snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} == 1)) OR (count by (snmp_group) (snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"}) * 0))

spec.title: Traffic In — Top 10 Devices (Stacked)
spec.description: Highest inbound bps per device, from the precomputed 5m octet rate rule.

spec.title: Syslog Volume by Device
spec.description: Device syslog volume by device ({service_name=alloy-syslog}).

spec.title: SNMP Trap Volume by Device
spec.description: SNMP trap volume by device ({service_name=alloy-snmptrap}).

spec.title: Top Devices by Event Volume (range)
spec.description: Syslog (A) + SNMP trap (B) counts per device over the range. Alloy streams alloy-syslog / alloy-snmptrap.

spec.title: Syslog Volume by Severity
spec.description: Device syslog volume by RFC5424 severity label ({service_name=alloy-syslog}).

spec.title: Recent Device Syslog
spec.description: Recent device syslog from Alloy loki.source.syslog (plain text, device_name label).

spec.title: Device Status
spec.description: Per-device snapshot. Polling Health is up{job=alloy-snmp,snmp_tier=hot} (not CPU linger). CPU/memory are current values. Click Device for details.

spec.expr: count by(device_name, snmp_group) (snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} == 2 and on(device_name, ifIndex) snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} == 1)

spec.title: Interfaces Down by Device
spec.description: Count of oper-down interfaces per device — high counts may indicate trunk failures or decommissioned ports

spec.expr: sort_desc((count by(device_name, snmp_group) (snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} == 2 and on(device_name, ifIndex) snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} == 1)) OR (max by(device_name, snmp_group) (snmp_CPU{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"}) * 0))

spec.title: Interface Up % by Device
spec.description: Percentage of interfaces in oper-up state per device. Low values flag bulk failures or decommissioned port blocks.

spec.expr:
sort_desc(
  count by(device_name, snmp_group) (snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} == 1 and on(device_name, ifIndex) snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} == 1)
  /
  count by(device_name, snmp_group) (snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} == 1)
  * 100
)

spec.title: Current CPU by Device
spec.description: Current CPU % per device, sorted descending

spec.title: CPU Utilization — Top 10 Devices
spec.description: CPU utilization over time for the top 10 busiest devices

spec.title: Total Fleet Traffic by Device (Stacked)
spec.description: Combined in+out traffic per device, stacked — use to identify which devices are driving aggregate spikes. Uses the precomputed 5m octet rate rules.

spec.title: Total Devices
spec.description: Unique devices reporting SNMP polling health

spec.title: Interfaces Down
spec.description: Count of interfaces currently in oper-down state across all devices

spec.title: Avg Fleet CPU
spec.description: Average of each device's max CPU — high values indicate broad fleet saturation

spec.title: Total Fleet Traffic
spec.description: Sum of inbound + outbound bits/sec across all device interfaces, from the precomputed 5m octet rate rules.

spec.title: Total Devices Δ 24h
spec.description: Absolute change in reporting devices vs 24h ago. Negative means devices stopped polling.

spec.expr:
count(count by(device_name) (snmp_device_info{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"}))
- (
  count(count by(device_name) (snmp_device_info{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} offset 24h))
  or
  count(count by(device_name) (snmp_device_info{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"}))
)

spec.title: Interfaces Down Δ 24h
spec.description: Absolute change in fleet-wide down interface count vs 24h ago. Positive = more outages.

spec.expr:
(count(snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} == 2 and on(device_name, ifIndex) snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} == 1) or vector(0))
- (
  (count(snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} offset 24h == 2 and on(device_name, ifIndex) snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} offset 24h == 1) or vector(0))
  or
  (count(snmp_ifOperStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} == 2 and on(device_name, ifIndex) snmp_ifAdminStatus{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} == 1) or vector(0))
)

spec.title: Avg Fleet CPU Δ 24h
spec.description: Change in average fleet CPU vs 24h ago. Positive = fleet is busier than yesterday.

spec.expr:
avg(max by(device_name) (snmp_CPU{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"}))
- (
  avg(max by(device_name) (snmp_CPU{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"} offset 24h))
  or
  avg(max by(device_name) (snmp_CPU{snmp_group=~"$snmp_group",device_name=~"$device_name"}))
)

spec.title: Fleet Traffic Δ 24h
spec.description: Change in total fleet traffic (bps) vs 24h ago. Zero indicates no change or data unavailable. Uses the precomputed 5m octet rate rules.

spec.title: A3. Alloy Device Summary
